tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Lena speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Long Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 40. I've been watching what you're becoming, little living. Names for your shelf: Long Table, Loud Chewer. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."
📖 Codex: Flash Photography — hits everything close around it. You won't forget this.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
